    SELECT DISTINCT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d

    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'Chinese Grand Prix'

      AND r.XCL_082 > 0

        qd.driver_id,

    WHERE r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL

            CAST(dbl.best_lap_time_str AS REAL)
    END AS best_lap_time_seconds

JOIN drivers d ON dbl.driver_id = d.XCL_034
ORDER BY best_lap_time_seconds ASC
